entities.summary: Craig Alan Biggio is an American former baseball second baseman, outfielder, and catcher who played 20 seasons in Major League Baseball for the Houston Astros, from 1988 to 2007. A seven-time National League (NL) All-Star often regarded as the greatest all-around player in Astros history, he is the only player ever to be named an All-Star and to be awarded Silver Slugger Award at both catcher and second base. With longtime teammates Jeff Bagwell and Lance Berkman, he formed the core of the "Killer B's" who led Houston to six playoff appearances from 1997 to 2005, culminating in the franchise's first World Series appearance in 2005.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Craig Biggio's seven National League All-Star appearances and two Silver Slugger Awards at both catcher and second base demonstrate his impact on Major League Baseball. His contributions to the Houston Astros' six playoff appearances from 1997 to 2005 helped shape the team's identity.
